testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hides a ribbon panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hides a ribbon panel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the expanded 3D Model ribbon shows the Modify panel ✔ And the Parameters panel is hidden ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector ✔ Then Parameters is unchecked ✔ And Modify is checked ✔ When the user selects Parameters in the panel list ✔ Then the Parameters panel appears in the ribbon ✔ And the panel list remains open with Parameters checked ✔ When the user selects Parameters again ✔ Then the Parameters panel disappears from the ribbon ✔ And the panel list remains open with Parameters unchecked ✔ And the part remains active
